name: Ducorp Trading Website

Built with Next.js 15, featuring server-side rendering, global CDN delivery, and a robust AWS-based deployment architecture with load balancing support.

Features crop management, expert consultations, online marketplace, and AI chatbot integration. Implemented CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment, and comprehensive monitoring.

name: Agrigate ERP

name: Agrigate Network Website

name: Twin Flow AI
description: Led development of HIPAA-compliant digital treatment planning platform for cardiac care. Built patient enrollment, service management, device tracking, and billing features. name: Twin Flow MIS
description: Developed Hospital Management & MIS system with patient-doctor dashboards, real-time cardiac rhythm monitoring, and automated alerts. Integrated AI/ML algorithms for cardiac rhythm analysis with role-based access for doctors, patients, and admins.

name: Skillamplify
